# cubepath_dns_record_health_check (Resource)

Manages the health check of an A or AAAA DNS record (one per record): while the endpoint fails, the record is left out of DNS answers. Needs a Pro or Business DNS plan and is billed monthly while enabled. Import with zone_uuid/record_uuid.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `check_type` (String) Probe: http, https, tcp or ping.
- `name` (String) Name of the check.
- `record_uuid` (String) UUID of the A or AAAA record.
- `zone_uuid` (String) UUID of the DNS zone.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the check runs (and is billed). Defaults to true.
- `expected_status` (Number) HTTP status that counts as healthy, for http and https. Defaults to 200.
- `healthy_threshold` (Number) Consecutive successes to mark it healthy, 1 to 10. Defaults to 2.
- `interval_secs` (Number) Seconds between probes, 10 to 3600. Defaults to 60.
- `path` (String) Path requested by http and https checks, starting with /.
- `port` (Number) Port to probe. Required for tcp; used by http and https.
- `target` (String) Hostname or IP to probe. Omit it to probe the record's own address.
- `timeout_secs` (Number) Probe timeout, 1 to 60 and lower than interval_secs. Defaults to 5.
- `unhealthy_threshold` (Number) Consecutive failures to mark it unhealthy, 1 to 10. Defaults to 3.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the health check.
- `last_status` (String) Last result: healthy, unhealthy or unknown.
